cases.title: embedded content leaves the lock literal

files.f/x.flow/flow.yaml:
value:
  modules:
    - id: a
      value:
        type: rawscript
        language: bun
        content: 'export function main() {}'
        lock: '!inline a.lock'
        input_transforms: {}

cases.note: the file name is the token !inline, which does not exist
cases.title: one leading space

files.f/x.flow/flow.yaml:
value:
  modules:
    - id: a
      value:
        type: rawscript
        language: bun
        content: '!inline a.ts'
        lock: ' !inline a.lock'
        input_transforms: {}

cases.note: the file name is empty, which names the flow folder itself
cases.title: two leading spaces

files.f/x.flow/flow.yaml:
value:
  modules:
    - id: a
      value:
        type: rawscript
        language: bun
        content: '!inline a.ts'
        lock: '  !inline a.lock'
        input_transforms: {}

value:
  modules:
    - id: a
      value:
        type: rawscript
        language: bun
        content: '!inline a.ts'
        lock: '!inline a.lock'
        input_transforms: {}

cases.title: the path is the second token only

files.f/x.flow/flow.yaml:
value:
  modules:
    - id: a
      value:
        type: rawscript
        language: bun
        content: '!inline a.ts trailing words'
        lock: '!inline a.lock and more'
        input_transforms: {}

cases.note: the trimmed string starts with !inline and the space-separated second token is a.lock
cases.title: a lock directive after a tab

files.f/x.flow/flow.yaml:
value:
  modules:
    - id: a
      value:
        type: rawscript
        language: bun
        content: '!inline a.ts'
        lock: "\t!inline a.lock"
        input_transforms: {}

cases.title: a lock without the space is literal

files.f/x.flow/flow.yaml:
value:

        type: rawscript
        language: bun
